evidence.quote: In the remainder of my remarks, I will focus on one important component of innovation policy--namely, government support for R&D.
Economic policy affects innovation and long-run economic growth in many ways.
However it is channeled, government support for innovation and R&D will be more effective if it is thought of as a long-run investment.
